name: Officer Hawkins
source:
Favorite food: Cajun blackened swordfish
Favorite horror movie: Gremlins 2
Worst habit: Way too into practical jokes

A local police officer affectionately known as The Scourge of Kettleboro Campus. He takes a special sort of glee in breaking up parties and terrorizing teens.

Ghosts? Don't know a damn thing about ghosts.
